title: Start Social Media Marketing for your Fitness Studio or Gym

facts.fact: The Appointy blog post 'How to Start Social Media Marketing for your Fitness Studio or Gym in 6 Simple Steps' was published on December 11, 2020.
The page states the guide covers six steps for starting social media marketing for a fitness studio or gym.
facts.quote: How to Start Social Media Marketing for your Fitness Studio or Gym in 6 Simple Steps

facts.fact: The page advises fitness business owners to start by listing about 15-20 businesses or brands they hear about as a benchmarking exercise before starting their own social media.
facts.quote: Start by making a list of about 15-20 businesses or brands that you hear a lot about.
